notes.title: New cozy game from the creators of Ikai is OUT NOW!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]After the spine-chilling journey of Ikai, our team has embarked on a new adventure, one that’s a bit—okay, very—different but just as special.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to share that our new cozy game [b]Instants has officially launched[/b] during Wholesome Direct! 🥳[/p][p][/p][p][b]Available NOW with a launch discount[/b], Instants is a heartwarming narrative puzzle game that we’ve truly poured our hearts into. While it’s a big shift from the horror of Ikai, we hope Instants brings you warmth and peace of mind during those breaks when all you want is to unwind.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948560"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]So... What is Instants?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Instants is a cozy narrative puzzle game where you piece together a family’s life story through photographs, assembling a chronological puzzle of heartwarming memories.[/p][p][/p][p]You’ll receive a collection of pictures that are all mixed up, and your job is to figure out the order in which the moments happened and arrange them correctly inside photo albums. As you do, the story of the family slowly comes together, little by little, photo by photo. Once everything is in the right order, you can decorate the pages using scrapbooking tools like stickers, washi tape, and pens to make each album your own.[/p][p][/p][p]The game isn’t fast-paced or stressful. Instants is a calm, reflective experience focused on concentration, discovery, creativity, and storytelling. If you enjoy games that invite you to slow down and really take in the details, Instants might be just what you’re looking for.[/p][list][*][p]🧩 Reconstruct memories[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]📖 Uncover a family's journey[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]🎨 Customize with Scrapbooking tools[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="cUbNEVRWaJE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Your support has meant everything along the way, which is why we hope Instants brings you comfort, joy, and maybe even a few tears (the good kind).[/p][p]Grab your favorite cup of tea and come join us on the bright side.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in Instants, 💖[/p][p]-Endflame team[/p]

notes.title: Announcing Instants - build & decorate cute photo albums
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Endflame here 👋

As part of today’s Wholesome Games Steam event, we’re so excited to finally share what we’ve been working on with a brand-new trailer!

[previewyoutube=F_-52YpAwqw;full][/previewyoutube]

Instants is a game about piecing together a family's life story by sorting through and selecting family photographs for a photo album. You can decorate the photo albums with stickers, coloured pens, sparkles and, very importantly, Washi tape (we love washi tape!).

Okay, we know that's not what some of you were expecting of our next game. It's not Ikai 2. It's a game to help you relax after a long day purifying shrines. 

If you are into this kind of games, please let us know what you think of the trailer and wishlist the game - it really does make all the difference.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948560/Instants/

That’s it for now, but we’ll be back soon with updates and new things to share.

Endflame team ❤️

notes.title: Ikai Patch v1.2.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Just wanted to inform you of the things we improved for this patch:

[list]
[*] Option to disable headbob
[*] The sticks of the well are easier to identify between the bones
[*] Fixed an issue where players that played the very first prototype on Itch.io and clicked continue the first time they play the game, resulted in a corrupted save file.
[*] Minor bugfixing
[/list]

Thank you so much for your continued support. If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please let us know!

notes.title: Demo Update v1.6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have made some changes to the demo thanks to the feedback of the players in order to improve the experience.

[b]OPTIMIZATION[/b]: the game should run much smoother and at a higher frame rate than before. If you are still experiencing low frame rates, consider lowering the shadows quality, this should help considerably.

[b]DRAWING:[/b] ok, it was too hard to draw the seal and very difficult with gamepad, sorry ːsteamsadː
Now, it's easier to do it correctly and doesn't require that much precision. Also, the precision needed with gamepad is different than with mouse. It won't require that much precision with gamepad.

[b]MINOR BUGFIXING[/b]: that's it, no more bugs.

Thanks to everyone that played the demo and to everyone that gave us feedback to improve the final game. We hope that these fixes address the main issues of the demo and help improving the experience.

If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please let us know!
